sentinel1.caveat: Sentinel-1 C-band linear polarisation; not comparable with the Mini-RF circular polarisation ratio. Cross-pol backscatter responds to volume scattering (vegetation, rough rock): context, not a test of the ranking. HH+HV and VV+VH values are not mixed in one comparison.
sentinel1.credit: Global Seasonal Sentinel-1 Interferometric Coherence and Backscatter Data Set (Kellndorfer et al. 2022), CC BY 4.0. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data.
sentinel1.method: median gamma0 in dB inside the site polygon (3 arcsec pixels), median of per-pixel cross/co ratio in dB; layover/shadow pixels of any relative orbit removed; JJA north of the equator, DJF south of it; arctic = |lat| >= 60

comparison_vv_vh.test: two-sided Mann-Whitney U on per-site medians (indicative: sites cluster by region)

source_row.agency: NASA JPL / Earth Big Data / Gamma RS

source_row.licence_or_citation: CC BY 4.0, 'Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data.' (read 15 Nov 2026 on the data set documentation page and the AWS registry entry); cite Kellndorfer et al. (2022), Scientific Data 9, 73, doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01189-6
